description: As a Software Asset Manager at a technology company, you have received the annual license audit report and must reconcile three software licenses in Snipe-IT. (1) Microsoft 365 Business Premium: The renewal contract reduced seats from 50 to 35 at a new annual cost of $9,240.00. Update the seat count to 35 and the purchase cost to $9,240.00. (2) Adobe Creative Cloud - All Apps: The team license has been upgraded from 10 to 15 seats at a total annual cost of $9,898.20. Update the seat count to 15 and the purchase cost to $9,898.20. (3) Windows 11 Enterprise: The volume licensing agreement has been extended. Update the expiration date from 2026-06-01 to 2028-06-01, and update the order number to 'PO-2025-0550-EXT'. Additionally, create a new license: 'Slack Business Plus' with serial 'SLACK-BP-2025-001', 20 seats, category 'Productivity Software', manufacturer 'Microsoft', purchase date '2025-03-01', purchase cost $3,000.00, expiration date '2026-03-01', order number 'PO-2025-0315', and note 'New team collaboration platform for all departments'.
